page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Two crops
steps.margin_note: Both names plus two spares. Four lines.
lines: Golden rice and Flavr Savr tomato are two more.
steps.why: Both carry a Bt gene, which is why they share the prefix and why the name says what was done to them.
common_mistakes: Naming a hybrid variety such as Sonalika. A hybrid is BRED, not genetically modified.
Naming one crop. The question asks for two.
steps.memory_tip: Bt cotton and Bt brinjal: the Bt is the modification.

steps.label: What each was modified for
steps.margin_note: Each crop with its pest, and the self-made insecticide point.

lines.text: Both carry a Bt gene for insect resistance
